Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that reserve adjustments stall when the primary approver is unavailable due to lack of delegation. I checked the five most similar items: Shortcut 4127 (bulk document upload), the Notion policyholder milestone notifications page, Shortcut 4129 (supplier contact details), the Notion reserve history audit export page, and Shortcut 4131 (workspace administration).
